title: Cross-Lingual Consensus: Aligning Multilingual Cultural Knowledge via Multilingual Self-Consistency

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to culturally grounded questions from the BLEnD benchmark to measure cultural alignment and the presence of Western-centric bias across 16 different cultural regions.

Measuring cross-lingual performance disparities by comparing the model's accuracy on culturally relevant and general reasoning benchmarks (BLEnD, M-HellaSwag, Global MMLU) when prompted in English versus various local languages.
